o: After their journey through the multiverse, Fionna and Cake tackle new adventures while Huntress Wizard embarks on a desperate quest with fatal consequences.

eps.o: After saving their world, Fionna and Cake try to find where they fit in. Huntress Wizard makes a disturbing discovery and turns to Simon for help.

eps.t: The Crocodile Who Bit a Log
eps.o: Fionna and Cake attempt to solve a heated debate with force. A desperate Huntress Wizard contends with a secret order of Wizards.
A nervous Cake goes on her first date. Fionna revisits an old flame. Huntress Wizard struggles to survive in a magic-free world.

eps.t: The Cat Who Tipped the Box
eps.o: While Cake explores a career in television, a heartbroken Fionna takes a walk down memory lane, and Huntress Wizard searches for a way home.
Despite several setbacks, Fionna redoubles her efforts to help her friends, while Cake and Huntress explore an enigmatic labyrinth.
During a night of strange visions, Huntress enlists Finn's allies to save him from an impending Croak Dream.
After a VIP goes missing, Fionna turns to magic and an unlikely ally for help, while Huntress conducts her own search.
When Fionna and Huntress Wizard are taken captive, Cake is left to pull off Boys Night on her own.
After plunging into the unknown, Fionna, Cake, and Huntress Wizard are forced to confront difficult truths.
As time runs out for a wounded hero, PB turns to science for solutions, while Huntress fights to make her way back to Ooo to stop her. Later, Fionna seeks to undo a disastrous decision.
